name: An easy flower
intro: Start the team to draw six square petals on spokes, each its own colour, and a stalk. Four robots share the jobs: go out to the petal, draw one side, come back to the centre, and draw the stalk. The spokes are drawn in invisible ink, so the whole flower is one drawing, and the colours wait in a queue on a nest. Click next member above Trained actions to see each robot. The pads on the table have things to try.

thing.text:
TRY

Set petals left to 3 and
"next spoke" from 240 to
300. Keep the square
corner at 90. Why do those
two turns have different
jobs?

Then sweep the flower up
with Dusty: one thing.

The colours wait on a nest:
put another on top.

active.name: Draw the stalk and rest

team.name: Go out to the petal
team.note: A petal begins. Walk out along a spoke in invisible ink, so the petals stand apart but the whole flower stays one drawing. Then the next colour: the top of the colours nest goes into the petal ink letter, a copy goes back to the nest by its bird (it lands underneath, so the colours go round), and the letter goes to the flower. The spoke is the first of the five petal steps.

team.name: Back to the centre
team.note: A square is finished. In invisible ink, turn about and walk the spoke back to the centre; turn to the next spoke, count one petal, and put five back into petal steps left.

team.name: Draw one side
team.note: Put the pen down, walk one side, turn a square corner, and count one step.

active.note: When no petals remain: green ink and pen down again (the spoke back was in invisible ink), draw down to the table, lift the pen and return to the centre. Put away the work box.
